title: UMC: A Universal Model Converter for Production AI
description: Model format fragmentation is one of the most critical interoperability challenges in production AI: 31+ formats (GGUF, ONNX, SafeTensors, PyTorch, TensorRT, CoreML, TFLite, ...) and 961 possible conversion paths, with no reliable tool to handle them all. We present UMC, an open-source infrastructure platform built in Rust that converts any model format to any other format without quality loss, at maximum speed, and with mathematical proof. UMC is built around a Universal Intermediate Representation (IR) that is a mathematical superset of all supported formats, guaranteeing bit-identical round-trips (SHA256 verified). A Dijkstra-based routing engine automatically finds the optimal conversion path, including multi-hop chains. A four-level validation pipeline (structural, numeric, functional, and round-trip certification with ed25519-signed certificates) provides mathematically verifiable proofs for every conversion. Memory-mapped I/O and a zero-copy pipeline enable conversion of 400 GB+ models with constant RAM usage. UMC is implemented in Rust and released under the Apache 2.0 license.
